sentences.zh: 谢谢你，罗曼。

sentences.zh: 谢里夫在这方面确实做得最好。

sentences.en: And it's funny to me because even though Daisuke was fired from his own band, he was a real
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为尽管大介被自己的乐队开除了，但他确实是个

sentences.en: hustler.
sentences.zh: 精明的生意人。

sentences.en: He got bars all over Kobe to lease these machines from him.
sentences.zh: 他让神户各地的酒吧都租用他的机器。

sentences.en: He got contracts with major record labels to use all these popular songs.
sentences.zh: 他还与各大唱片公司签约，获得了这些流行歌曲的使用权。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But he didn't patent the machine.
sentences.zh: 但他没有给这台机器申请专利。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 噢，不。

sentences.en: He says, when I first made the Juke Ats, a brother-in-law suggested I take out a patent.
sentences.zh: 他说，当我第一次做出Juke 8时，一位姐夫建议我申请专利。

sentences.en: But at the time, I didn't think anything would come of it.
sentences.zh: 但当时，我没觉得这会有什么大不了的。

sentences.en: I was just hoping the drinking places in the Kobe area would use my machine.
sentences.zh: 我只是希望神户地区的饮酒场所能用我的机器。

sentences.en: Most people don't believe me when I say this, but I don't think karaoke would have taken off
sentences.zh: 当我说这话时，大多数人都不相信，但我认为如果第一台机器申请了专利，

sentences.en: You know, it's a really nice and joyful thing, even though I've never participated in it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这真的是一件美好而快乐的事，尽管我从未参与过。

sentences.en: It's a nice and joyful thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件美好而快乐的事。

sentences.en: And it's actually nice to think of it as it just existing in the world to make the world
sentences.zh: 想到它只是为了让世界变得更美好而存在，而不是为了让他赚钱，

sentences.en: better and not necessarily to make him money.
sentences.zh: 这感觉真好。

sentences.en: Yeah, it does make some people money.
sentences.zh: 是啊，它确实让一些人赚到了钱。

sentences.zh: 确实有另一个人给激光视盘卡拉OK机申请了专利。

sentences.en: Oh, God.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: But he's not part of this story.
sentences.zh: 但他不是这个故事的一部分。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: God, no.
sentences.zh: 天哪，当然不是。

sentences.en: Let's write him out of history.
sentences.zh: 让我们把他从历史中抹去吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: And then Daisuke goes on.
sentences.zh: 然后大介继续说。

sentences.en: Besides, I didn't build the thing from scratch.
sentences.zh: 再说，我并不是从零开始制造这东西的。

sentences.en: The amp, the microphone, the 8-track player, even the 100-yen box machine all had patents on them.
sentences.zh: 功放、麦克风、八轨播放器，甚至那个100日元的投币箱，本身都有专利。

sentences.en: Yeah, but that's not how patents work.
sentences.zh: 是啊，但专利不是这么运作的。

sentences.en: He could have totally gotten a patent for it.
sentences.zh: 他完全可以为它申请专利的。

sentences.en: You think so?
sentences.zh: 你这么认为？

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 绝对可以。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't know anything about patent law, especially Japanese patent law.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我对专利法一窍不通，尤其是日本专利法。

sentences.en: Well, I don't know about Japanese patent law, and I actually am no expert of U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不了解日本专利法，其实我也不是美国

sentences.en: patent law.
sentences.zh: 专利法的专家。

sentences.en: But if you come up with a new use for even a known thing and prescribe that use inside of the patent,
sentences.zh: 但如果你为已知的东西想出了新用途，并在专利中规定了这种用途，

sentences.en: it doesn't have to be three machines.
sentences.zh: 它不一定非得是三台机器。

sentences.en: It could be one machine to do a certain thing, as long as you change a little bit something and change its purpose.
sentences.zh: 它可以是一台机器用来做某件事，只要你做了一点点改动并改变了它的用途。

sentences.en: So he totally had the right to a patent, for sure.
sentences.zh: 所以他绝对有权申请专利。

sentences.en: So this is just more of him talking smack on himself.
sentences.zh: 所以这更多是他自己在贬低自己。

sentences.en: But yeah, what I really love about this story on a whole is that he seems pretty okay with how all of this turned out.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，我真正喜欢这个故事的地方在于，他似乎对自己所经历的一切感到相当满足。

sentences.en: You know, he talks a lot about just like how glad he is that this brought so much joy into the world.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他经常谈到他有多高兴这给世界带来了这么多欢乐。

sentences.en: And he says, I may not have the original patent.
sentences.zh: 他说，我可能没有原始专利。

sentences.en: Some say I would have made $80 million last year, and that was a bad year.
sentences.zh: 有人说我去年本可以赚8000万美元，而那还是糟糕的一年。

sentences.en: But I have good friends and a family I love, and I can't help but smile every day.
sentences.zh: 但我有很好的朋友和深爱的家人，我每天都忍不住微笑。

sentences.en: Do you have a thing to sum up, or is that it?
sentences.zh: 你有什么总结吗，还是就这样了？

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess the last thing was I just wanted to say that Daisuke says that to honor karaoke,
sentences.zh: 是啊，我想最后一点是，大介说为了纪念卡拉OK，

sentences.en: he and his wife and daughter and three granddaughters get out a songbook once a week
sentences.zh: 他和妻子、女儿以及三个孙女每周会拿出一本歌本，

sentences.en: About a year ago, our senior editor, Delaney Hall, moved from beautiful downtown Oakland,
sentences.zh: 大约一年前，我们的高级编辑德莱尼·霍尔从加州美丽的奥克兰市中心，

sentences.en: California, back to New Mexico, where she grew up.
sentences.zh: 搬回了她长大的新墨西哥州。

sentences.en: She now works for 99PI remotely, and her mini-story is about this phenomenon in the new city
sentences.zh: 她现在远程为99PI工作，她的小故事是关于她居住的新城市——

sentences.en: where she lives, which is Santa Fe.
sentences.zh: 圣达菲的一种现象。

sentences.en: The phenomenon is called Zosobra.
sentences.zh: 这种现象叫“佐佐布拉”（Zosobra）。

sentences.en: Zosobra is a big deal here in Santa Fe.
sentences.zh: 佐佐布拉在圣达菲可是件大事。

sentences.en: Basically, every year, a group of people in the city build this enormous marionette that's
sentences.zh: 基本上，每年城市里的一群人都会制作一个巨大的木偶，

sentences.en: named Zosobra.
sentences.zh: 名字就叫佐佐布拉。

sentences.en: And in Spanish, Zosobra means anxiety.
sentences.zh: 在西班牙语中，Zosobra的意思是“焦虑”。

sentences.en: So he's like all of the city's collective sorrows embodied in this huge puppet.
sentences.zh: 所以他就像是这座城市所有集体悲伤的化身，体现在这个巨大的木偶身上。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太神奇了。

sentences.en: So what does he look like?
sentences.zh: 那他长什么样？

sentences.en: Well, he's 50 feet tall.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他有50英尺高。

sentences.en: He is dressed in a long white gown.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件长长的白袍。

sentences.en: He has these very dark, angry eyes.
sentences.zh: 他有着非常深邃、愤怒的眼睛。

sentences.en: They're usually rimmed with green or black.
sentences.zh: 眼眶通常是绿色或黑色的。

sentences.en: And what happens is that every fall, this group constructs a new Zosobra, and about 50,000 people
sentences.zh: 每年秋天，这群人会建造一个新的佐佐布拉，大约5万人

sentences.en: gather in one of Santa Fe's biggest parks, and they burn him.
sentences.zh: 聚集在圣达菲最大的公园之一，然后把他烧掉。

sentences.en: Wow, they burn him, a 50-foot puppet.
sentences.zh: 哇，他们烧掉他，一个50英尺高的木偶。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a very intense kind of pagan-feeling event.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一种非常强烈的、带有异教色彩的活动。

sentences.en: I mean, basically, the crowd chants, burn him, burn him, burn him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，基本上人群会高喊：烧掉他，烧掉他，烧掉他。

sentences.en: And he's set on fire, and he is slowly engulfed in flames.
sentences.zh: 然后他被点燃，慢慢地被火焰吞噬。

sentences.en: And I assume they burn him so they can burn their collective anxiety that he represents.
sentences.zh: 我想他们烧掉他是为了烧掉他所代表的集体焦虑。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: So because he represents gloom, it's this way that the city purges its sadness every year.
sentences.zh: 所以因为他代表忧郁，这是这座城市每年清除悲伤的一种方式。

sentences.en: And people get to participate in these interesting ways.
sentences.zh: 人们以这些有趣的方式参与其中。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons Zosobra is so flammable is that he is stuffed with bushels of shredded paper.
sentences.zh: 佐佐布拉之所以这么易燃，是因为他肚子里塞满了成捆的碎纸。

sentences.en: And where that paper comes from is in the weeks leading up to the burning,
sentences.zh: 而这些纸的来源，是在焚烧前的几周里，

sentences.en: anyone with an excess of gloom is encouraged to sort of write down their gloomy thoughts on a piece of paper
sentences.zh: 鼓励任何心中郁闷的人把他们的忧郁想法写在纸上，

sentences.en: and to leave it in this thing called the gloom box, which at least in the past has been located in the offices of one of the local newspapers.
sentences.zh: 然后投进这个叫“忧郁箱”的东西里，至少在过去，它一直放在当地一家报社的办公室里。

sentences.en: So people contribute police reports and mortgage documents and divorce papers.
sentences.zh: 所以人们会贡献出警察报告、抵押贷款文件和离婚协议书。

sentences.en: I mean, just anything they might want to burn.
sentences.zh: 我是说，任何他们想烧掉的东西都可以。

sentences.en: It reminds me of other sort of bonfire rituals like Burning Man or something, which a lot of people go to around here.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了其他篝火仪式，比如“火人节”之类的，这附近很多人都会去参加。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, Zosobra has been around a lot longer than Burning Man.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我是说，佐佐布拉的历史可比火人节悠久多了。

sentences.en: It's been around since the 1920s.
sentences.zh: 它从20世纪20年代就开始了。

sentences.en: But there are definitely some similarities.
sentences.zh: 但它们确实有一些相似之处。

sentences.en: Like, both were developed by artists.
sentences.zh: 比如，两者都是由艺术家开发的。

sentences.en: Both events began relatively small, like in someone's backyard or on a beach, and then grew into something much bigger.
sentences.zh: 两个活动起初规模都相对较小，比如在某人的后院或海滩上，后来才发展成规模宏大的活动。

sentences.en: And both actually draw on other traditions that go back even farther.
sentences.zh: 而且两者实际上都借鉴了更古老的传统。

sentences.en: But one thing that's pretty neat about Zosobra is that because he's a puppet, he's capable of kind of rudimentary movement.
sentences.zh: 但佐佐布拉有一点很特别，因为他是个木偶，他能做出一些基本的动作。

sentences.en: So his arms swing around, his jaw is hinged, so his mouth opens and closes.
sentences.zh: 所以他的手臂会摆动，下巴有铰链，嘴巴能一张一合。

sentences.en: And he also makes sound.
sentences.zh: 而且他还会发出声音。

sentences.en: So I'm going to play a little bit of sound of the event so you can hear it.
sentences.zh: 所以我打算放一段活动现场的声音，让你们听听。

sentences.en: And I assume he's flailing at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我猜他同时还在挥舞手臂。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's flailing.
sentences.zh: 没错，他在挥舞。

sentences.en: His mouth is opening and closing.
sentences.zh: 他的嘴在开合。

sentences.en: It's a really, it's actually a really troubling event to go to as a kid.
sentences.zh: 作为一个孩子去参加这个活动，其实真的挺让人不安的。

sentences.en: It is sort of seared into my memory.
sentences.zh: 它在我的记忆里烙下了印记。

sentences.en: But this is actually like the thing I most want to tell you about because I recently learned just in the past year or so that the voice of Zosobra is performed live.
sentences.zh: 但这其实是我最想告诉你的事，因为我最近才了解到，就在过去一年左右，佐佐布拉的声音是现场配音的。

sentences.en: And there is one guy who's been doing the voice for about 20 years.
sentences.zh: 有一个人已经为这个角色配音大约20年了。

sentences.en: And I learned this thanks to this gem of local reporting from KOET Action 7 News.
sentences.zh: 我是通过KOET第七频道新闻的一段当地报道了解到这一点的。

sentences.en: Me, I see him as an old, grumpy old man.
sentences.zh: 我呢，我把他看作一个脾气暴躁的老头。

sentences.en: And that's the character that I get into.
sentences.zh: 这就是我进入的角色状态。

sentences.en: This is the Zosobra you know.
sentences.zh: 这就是你们所熟知的佐佐布拉。

sentences.en: They want to get rid of him.
sentences.zh: 他们想除掉他。

sentences.en: They want to destroy him.
sentences.zh: 他们想摧毁他。

sentences.en: They want to burn him.
sentences.zh: 他们想烧掉他。

sentences.en: And my, the way I play the character is I'm fighting to stay alive.
sentences.zh: 而我，我演绎这个角色的方式就是，我在为生存而战。

sentences.en: On Friday, Michael Ellis will take on the persona of our collective sorrow for the 19th time.
sentences.zh: 周五，迈克尔·埃利斯将第19次化身为我们集体忧郁的象征。

sentences.en: And despite the title of Old Man Gloom, Zosobra's voice battles several emotions.
sentences.zh: 尽管被称为“忧郁老头”，但佐佐布拉的声音中交织着多种情绪。

sentences.en: There are times when he'll sound like he's crying.
sentences.zh: 有时他听起来像是在哭泣。

sentences.en: Protesting.
sentences.zh: 抗议。

sentences.en: Adamant.
sentences.zh: 坚定。

sentences.en: I'm not going to let you do this to me again.
sentences.zh: 我不会再让你们对我做这种事了。

sentences.en: Ellis, as the audience of 50,000, should always know what Zosobra is feeling.
sentences.zh: 埃利斯认为，面对5万名观众，他们应该时刻感受到佐佐布拉的情绪。

sentences.en: Not only do I want the crowd to hear him, I want them to feel him.
sentences.zh: 我不仅希望人群能听到他的声音，更希望他们能感受到他。

sentences.en: And even after 19 years for Ellis, the big night is always exciting.
sentences.zh: 即使对埃利斯来说已经过去了19年，那个大日子依然让人兴奋。

sentences.en: I'll sit down and have a sandwich in the early afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我会在下午早些时候坐下来吃个三明治。

sentences.en: After that, I've got butterflies and I won't have anything until after it's all over.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我就开始紧张了，直到一切结束前我什么都吃不下。

sentences.en: On Friday night, those butterflies join all of New Mexico's gloom up in smoke.
sentences.zh: 周五晚上，那些紧张感将伴随着新墨西哥州所有的忧郁化为烟雾。

sentences.en: Yeah, I just, I love this news clip so much.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我太喜欢这段新闻片段了。

sentences.en: I think it's one of my favorites ever.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是我最喜欢的片段之一。

sentences.en: And it's the combination of the reporter's seriousness or maybe mock seriousness and then just like the sublime ridiculousness of what you're seeing,
sentences.zh: 这结合了记者严肃——或者说是假装严肃——的态度，以及你所看到的这种极其荒谬的场面，

sentences.en: which of course people can't see it.
sentences.zh: 当然人们现在看不到。

sentences.en: But to describe it, it's Michael Ellis, the voice of Zosobra, performing the sounds of Zosobra, but to this big, empty baseball field, which, you know,
sentences.zh: 但描述一下的话，就是佐佐布拉的配音演员迈克尔·埃利斯，正在对着一个巨大的、空荡荡的棒球场表演佐佐布拉的声音，你知道的，

sentences.en: probably later in the night will be filled with 50,000, 60,000 screaming people.
sentences.zh: 可能到了晚上晚些时候，这里会挤满5万、6万名尖叫的观众。

sentences.en: But at the moment, it's just entirely empty.
sentences.zh: 但此刻，这里完全是空的。

sentences.en: Oh, that's so good.
sentences.zh: 哦，那太棒了。

sentences.en: So you get like a little taste of what Michael Ellis is about, but what is he really like?
sentences.zh: 所以你对迈克尔·埃利斯有了一点了解，但他本人到底是什么样呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, so this was the only thing I could find on the internet about him.
sentences.zh: 是啊，这是我在网上能找到的关于他的唯一信息。

sentences.en: And from seeing this clip, I definitely wanted to learn more.
sentences.zh: 看了这段视频后，我真的很想了解更多。

sentences.en: And so I looked him up and went to talk with him.
sentences.zh: 所以我查了他的资料，并去和他谈了谈。

sentences.en: And what I learned is that he was born and raised in Santa Fe.
sentences.zh: 我了解到他是在圣达菲出生长大的。

sentences.en: And so Michael told me that, you know, as a kid, Zosobra was like this figure, this monster who almost seemed real, like actually alive.

sentences.en: Like they drained the basement and they added some new windows and they put up a security fence.
sentences.zh: 所以显然那一定是在钟被偷之后发生的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So obviously that must have happened after the clock was stolen.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 他们肯定意识到东西正在从大楼里消失。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 我想他们是想阻止这种情况。

sentences.en: They definitely were aware that things were disappearing from the building.
sentences.zh: 我是说，很多人参观这座建筑是为了拍照，或者只是为了探索它。

sentences.en: And I think they wanted to put a stop to that.
sentences.zh: 但在此过程中，数百件文物也被拿走了。

sentences.en: I mean, a lot of people were visiting this building to take pictures or, you know, just explore it.
sentences.zh: 所以这个钟真的只是拼图的一块。

sentences.en: But along the way, hundreds of artifacts were taken, too.
sentences.zh: 有很多小东西从这座建筑里被拿走。

sentences.en: So the clock is really just one piece of the puzzle.
sentences.zh: 我可以想象多年来发生了什么。

sentences.en: There were lots of little things taken from this building.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I can imagine over the years.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常大的物件，需要多人才能搬动，但绝对是众多失窃物品之一。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 而归还它实际上引发了一场更大的运动。

sentences.en: A really large piece that took, you know, multiple people to move, but definitely one of many things.
sentences.zh: 因为一旦福特拿到了钟，他们就能发出呼吁说，嘿，看，有人归还了这个钟。

sentences.en: And returning it actually started this kind of bigger movement.
sentences.zh: 如果还有其他人有东西，也许你们也可以把它还回来。

sentences.en: Because once Ford had the clock in hand, they were able to put out a call and say, hey, look, somebody return this clock.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你不会有麻烦的。

sentences.en: If anybody else has stuff, maybe you could bring it back, too.
sentences.zh: 既往不咎。

sentences.en: And, you know, you won't get in trouble.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: No questions asked.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: Just leave it on the side of a building.
sentences.zh: 就把它留在建筑物的一侧就行。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And it worked.
sentences.zh: 而且这招奏效了。

sentences.en: Dozens of people have now come forward to offer up old station artifacts, including fountains and plaster medallies.
sentences.zh: 现在已经有几十人主动联系，希望能捐出旧车站的文物，包括喷泉和石膏奖章。

sentences.en: Light fixtures and all kinds of stuff.
sentences.zh: 灯具以及各种各样的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And Ford actually has a wish list, too.
sentences.zh: 而且福特公司其实也有一份愿望清单。

sentences.en: They want back things like the ticket window grills, elevator transom panels, other clocks that have disappeared over the years.
sentences.zh: 他们想要找回像售票窗口的格栅、电梯横梁面板，以及多年来遗失的其他时钟等物品。

sentences.en: And basically, you know, anything that is sort of considered critical to the historic character of the building.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你知道，任何被认为对建筑的历史风貌至关重要的东西。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what are they planning to restore it as it was?
sentences.zh: 那他们打算将其恢复成原来的样子吗？

sentences.en: What are they planning to do with all these artifacts?
sentences.zh: 他们打算怎么处理这些文物？

sentences.en: Well, some things will probably go back into the building and others will end up in local museuMs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有些东西可能会放回建筑里，其他的则会进入当地的博物馆。

sentences.en: And one of the sort of side benefits is that some of these things can be used to model copies, too.
sentences.zh: 而且额外的好处之一是，其中一些东西还可以用来制作复制品。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, if you have one plaster medallion, you can make a bunch of other ones put in the renovated building.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你有一个石膏奖章，你就可以制作出一堆其他的，安装在翻新后的建筑里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很有道理。

sentences.en: So, is the idea that this thing is going to be like a passenger train terminal again, or is it something different?
sentences.zh: 那么，他们的想法是让这里重新成为客运火车站，还是会有所不同？

sentences.en: No, it's going to be something different.
sentences.zh: 不，它会变得有所不同。

sentences.en: Basically, Ford hired Snow Hedda, this sort of famous international design firm, to help them build out a new campus.
sentences.zh: 基本上，福特聘请了著名的国际设计公司 Snohetta 来帮助他们打造一个新的园区。

sentences.en: They're calling it the Corktown Campus.
sentences.zh: 他们将其称为“科克敦园区”。

sentences.en: And it's going to be the center for Ford to develop, you know, autonomous vehicles and other urban road-related technologies in a nice central area where they can do, like,
sentences.zh: 它将成为福特开发自动驾驶汽车和其他城市道路相关技术的中心，位于一个理想的中心区域，他们可以在那里进行，比如，

sentences.en: actual on-the-road testing.
sentences.zh: 实际的道路测试。

sentences.en: And the station itself is going to be at the heart of this.
sentences.zh: 而车站本身将成为这一切的核心。

sentences.en: And it's going to be repopulated, actually, with a lot of the same things they had before, like restaurants and shops.
sentences.zh: 而且它实际上会被重新注入活力，恢复以前的许多功能，比如餐厅和商店。

sentences.en: And above, there are going to be offices, but also condos now.
sentences.zh: 楼上将会有办公室，现在还会有公寓。

sentences.en: And the idea is that Ford can, you know, move some of its people and its partner organizations up into these spaces.
sentences.zh: 他们的想法是，福特可以把一些员工和合作机构搬进这些空间里。

sentences.en: Have you seen pictures of the artifacts and the renovation at all?
sentences.zh: 你看过文物和翻新工程的照片吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 看过。

sentences.en: There are some great images of the clock and it sitting outside wrapped up.
sentences.zh: 有一些很棒的照片，展示了那个时钟被包裹着放在外面的样子。

sentences.en: And there are a lot of historic photos that kind of show what was there, what's missing, and, you know,
sentences.zh: 还有很多历史照片，展示了那里曾经有什么，现在缺了什么，还有，你知道，

sentences.en: Ford's plan for what this building is going to look like when they're all done with this campus.
sentences.zh: 福特对这个园区完工后建筑外观的规划。

sentences.en: That's awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And can you put them on the website for us?
sentences.zh: 你能把它们放到网站上供我们查看吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，没问题。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: That sounds good.
sentences.zh: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you, Kurt.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，库尔特。
